views.title: Every view
views.statement: Show every screen of the app being modelled at once, as each renders today.

views.title: A view
views.statement: Everything about one screen in one place: how it renders, what it has to do, what state it can be in, and a way to ask for a change.

views.title: A table
views.statement: Show a list the project already keeps as JSON, without the tool learning what the rows mean.

views.title: A sketch
views.statement: Draw a screen that does not exist yet, for the one job that genuinely wants a canvas.

views.title: All books
views.statement: List the projects being modelled, when more than one is served.

states.title: Nothing renders yet
states.statement: A project with no screenshots in img/ shows cards that say so rather than blanks.

states.title: Following the session
states.statement: The conversation is polled and shown under the ask box.

states.title: Nowhere to say it
states.statement: No session is running, so asking says so instead of silently dropping the message.

stories.title: See what the app looks like now
stories.statement: I want every screen in front of me as it currently renders, not as it was drawn.

stories.title: Ask for a change where I noticed it
stories.statement: I want to say what is wrong with a screen from the page showing that screen.

stories.title: Trust that what I say arrived
stories.statement: I want to see that a message went somewhere, and see the answer come back.

requirements.title: A card per view, carrying its render
requirements.statement: Every view of the modelled app is a card with its current screenshot, cropped so the screen is recognisable.

requirements.title: Say what is built and what is not
requirements.statement: Each card carries how many of that view's requirements are built, broken or missing.

requirements.title: The render beside the requirements
requirements.statement: The screenshot sits next to what the view has to do, bounded by the window so a tall phone screen does not fill it.

requirements.title: A box to ask from, with a button
requirements.statement: What is typed goes to the conversation, the page says it went, and the tail of that conversation appears underneath.

requirements.title: Paste a screenshot into the ask
requirements.statement: A pasted image is kept as a file in the project and its path travels with the message, because a conversation can be handed a path and not a clipboard.

requirements.title: Set a requirement's status in place
requirements.statement: Built, broken or missing is one click, written straight into model.json.

requirements.title: Notes that are saved and announced once
requirements.statement: A note saves as it is typed and is announced when the field is left, rather than sending a message per keystroke.

requirements.title: The page follows the files
requirements.statement: When the agent writes model.json or a render, every open page updates itself.

requirements.title: Tables are declared, not coded
requirements.statement: A project says which of its JSON files to show and what each column means; the tool never learns what the rows are about.

requirements.title: The canvas is behind its own address
requirements.statement: Sketching is one job among many and does not get to be the container for the rest.

requirements.title: A project per path
requirements.statement: Several projects are served at once, each under its own name, so a link to a view stays a link to that view.

requirements.title: Add a view or a requirement from the page
requirements.statement: Status and notes can be edited; adding anything cannot, so the model still has to be written by hand or by a script.

requirements.title: A glance at the code structure
requirements.statement: Show the broad shape of the codebase being modelled - what lives where, how large it is, and where the same thing is done twice - so duplication and drift are visible without reading the code.

requirements.title: Renders that refresh themselves
requirements.statement: A project declares the command that produces img/, and viewbook runs it rather than waiting for someone to remember.

requirements.title: A render of whatever shape the screen is
requirements.statement: A view can carry an upright render and a wide one. Which is which is measured from the image, so an upright screen stands beside the conversation and a wide one takes the width.

requirements.title: The render, the question and the answer come first
requirements.statement: Those three fill the screen. What the view has to do, the states it can be in and the notes sit behind a fold that opens itself only when the window has room for them.

requirements.title: Only whoever holds the key can open it
requirements.statement: What is typed here reaches a session that can run commands. Every request has to be same-origin and has to carry a key kept in a file readable by its owner alone.

requirements.title: Installs without cloning anything
requirements.statement: nix run, nix profile install or go install. The interface is committed built and embedded in the binary, so there is no node step.
